summary: CacheLayer (single-flight, cross-process lock, TTL jitter) over memory/Redis/Dragonfly; Redis outage degrades to uncached operation (tested); shared Redis GCRA rate limiter. Cached-read benchmark recorded: memory 125k, Redis 57k, Dragonfly 54k req/s (baseline). Redis session cache deliberately not enabled (ADR 0004, evidence: sessions are 1 of 2-3 DB round trips; revocation must be immediate), so the fail-open criterion holds by construction.
